project_context.industry: Soft Skills, CRT Training, Professional Etiquette
project_context.target_audience: Students, Corporate Professionals, Institutions in AP, India
project_context.design_ethos: Awwwards Site-of-the-Day level. Premium, structured, high-contrast, motion-rich, authoritative. A hybrid of luxury editorial and high-performance corporate architecture.

scale.labels: text-xs md:text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#D9A23B]

rules.headings: Must be Space Grotesk, Bold. Use wide letter-spacing on subheadings only.
rules.labels: Must be IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, widely tracked (tracking-[0.2em]).
rules.body: Must be Inter, regular weight. Do not use Inter for headings.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Use 12-column bento grids for high-density areas. Use asymmetric 4-column spans for visual tension on marketing pages.
spacing_and_layout.alternating_sections: Strict rhythm: deep_navy -> page_background_ivory -> white. Ensure high contrast at the borders.

component_styling.border_radius: Sharp edges. Use maximum `rounded-md` (4-6px). STRICTLY NO PILL SHAPES.

cards.base: bg-white or bg-[#0B1F3D] depending on section. 1px subtle border border-black/5 or border-white/10.
cards.signature_accent: EVERY card MUST have a 3px top-border of gold (#D9A23B) via `border-t-[3px] border-t-[#D9A23B]`.

buttons.primary: bg-[#D9A23B] text-[#071527] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-sm px-8 py-4 rounded-[4px] hover:bg-[#F2C46D] transition-colors duration-300
buttons.secondary: border border-[#D9A23B] text-[#D9A23B] uppercase tracking-wider text-sm px-8 py-4 rounded-[4px] hover:bg-[#D9A23B] hover:text-[#071527] transition-colors duration-300

navbar.styling: bg-[#071527]/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10. Logo text with gold gradient `bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r from-[#D9A23B] to-[#F2C46D]`.
navbar.cta: Gold CTA button on the right.

whatsapp_button.styling: Fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 bg-[#25D366] text-white p-4 rounded-full shadow-lg hover:scale-110 transition-transform duration-300 cursor-pointer

motion_and_animation.scrolling: Implement @studio-freight/react-lenis for premium momentum scrolling. This is MANDATORY for the 'Awwwards' feel.

kinetic_hero_text.implementation: Wrap lines in `overflow-hidden`. Use framer-motion to translate Y from `100%` to `0%` with a custom easing cubic-bezier(0.76, 0, 0.24, 1) over 1.2s.

motion_and_animation.scroll_reveals: Use `whileInView` framer-motion triggers. Subtle Y-axis translation (`y: 40` to `y: 0`) and opacity fade in (`opacity: 0` to `1`). Add staggered delays (e.g., `staggerChildren: 0.1`) for grids.
motion_and_animation.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Slow, editorial drift. IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, light gold on deep navy background. Content: 'SPEAK. SHINE. SUCCEED. • EVERY VOICE HAS AN ASCENT • '
motion_and_animation.parallax_moment: Apply subtle `useScroll` and `useTransform` from framer-motion on hero background elements and the founder photo to move at 0.5x scroll speed.

hero_art_direction.background: Deep navy (#071527) with a gold dot-grid / radial dot pattern texture (opacity 10-15%).
hero_art_direction.typography: Massive 'Every voice has an' (White) + 'ascent.' (Gold #D9A23B). Masked line reveal.
hero_art_direction.graphics: Animated gold ascending growth-curve SVG intersecting behind the text. Path length animation using framer-motion (`strokeDasharray`, `strokeDashoffset`).
hero_art_direction.layout: Bottom of hero should feature a high-contrast stats bar traversing the full width.

image_treatment_and_urls.rules: Real product photography. Apply a 'spotlight' effect (radial gradient overlay) or 'clipped frames' (sharp rectangular masks with slight offset borders).

founder_photo.treatment: Place in a sharp rectangular frame. Use a gold 3px top border on the container. Add a subtle grayscale filter that transitions to full color on hover.

training_culture.treatment: Clipped rectangular frames overlapping slightly, casting subtle shadows on the ivory background.

programs_preview.treatment: Use inside cards with sharp 4px radius and gold top border.

Home.voktaa_acronym_strip: 6 vertical or horizontal letter cards on dark navy, revealing on scroll.
Home.4e_model: Horizontal 4-step timeline on dark navy. Connecting gold line must animate width on scroll using framer-motion.

About.origin_story: Large editorial pull-quote with a solid 4px gold left-border.
About.manifesto: Numbered chapters using massive Space Grotesk numbers (opacity-20 watermark style) behind IBM Plex Mono text.
About.vision_mission: Sharp dark navy boxes placed asymmetrically.

Programs.program_cards: Detailed cards for Little Voices, Speak Bold, Launchpad 360. Include level badges and module bento grids.

Contact.layout: Split layout. Dark navy info card on left, white enquiry form on right. Form must use strict rectangular inputs, no rounded pills. Focus state: `ring-1 ring-[#D9A23B] border-transparent`.

admin_dashboard_styling.theme: Clean premium data cockpit. Must feel like a high-end financial terminal. Avoid basic SaaS looks.
admin_dashboard_styling.background: Deep navy (#071527) for sidebar, #FAF7F2 (ivory) for main content area to reduce eye strain for admins.
admin_dashboard_styling.typography: High legibility. Space Grotesk for metric totals, Inter for tables, IBM Plex Mono for timestamps and labels.
admin_dashboard_styling.cards: White background, sharp edges (4px), 3px gold top border. Use Shadcn UI charts customized with brand colors (#0B1F3D, #D9A23B).
admin_dashboard_styling.metrics: Display Cards for: Visits, Form Submissions, Contact Clicks, Program-Choice breakdown.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Strictly honor the mandated colors and fonts. DO NOT introduce new colors outside the brand palette.
DO NOT use generic centered layouts. Emphasize asymmetry and editorial grid structures.
Every card MUST have the signature 3px gold top border. This is non-negotiable.
Use framer-motion for ALL scroll reveals. Static elements are forbidden on marketing pages.
Ensure lenis is configured in the root layout for smooth scrolling.
All interactive elements (buttons, form inputs) must have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="contact-submit-button"`).
Maintain strict border-radius limits (max 6px). NO pill-shaped buttons or input fields.
Avoid using `transparent` for the navbar. Use `bg-[#071527]/90 backdrop-blur-xl`.
